# opsramp_user_group (Resource)

Manages an OpsRamp User Group resource. User groups organize users and can be assigned roles.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the user group.

### Optional

- `client` (String) The client (tenant) UUID where this user should be created. If not specified, uses the provider's tenant.
- `description` (String) The description of the user group.
- `roles` (Set of String) List of role IDs assigned to the group.
- `unique_id` (String) A unique identifier for the user group.
- `users` (Set of String) List of user IDs in the group.

## Example Usage
```terraform
# User Group for Client Admins
resource "opsramp_user_group" "client_admin_group" {
  name        = "Admin User Group"
  description = "User group for client administrators"

  roles = [
    opsramp_role.client_admin_role.id
  ]

  users = [
    opsramp_user.admin.id
  ]
}
```
